finding.comment: stages_jsonl is written one object per line, but any(.[]; .failed) assumes the input is a single array document; on each per-line object .[] iterates the object's own fields, so the gate misreads the documented input format.

files.patch:
--- a/scripts/plan_gate.sh
+++ b/scripts/plan_gate.sh
@@ -5,4 +5,6 @@
 set -euo pipefail
+jq -c '.stages[]' <<<"$plan" >>"$stages_jsonl"
+if jq -e 'any(.[]; .failed)' <"$stages_jsonl" >/dev/null; then
+  echo "a deployment stage failed" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi

rationale: 18C replacement of the out-of-scope length fixture: unslurped array consumer (.[]) over an added JSONL producer, the frozen-definition relation semantics, with distinct names and a non-negated guard shape.
